description: This file defines the AttributeObjectHelper class, which assists in extracting and formatting specific attributes from a SugarBean object for JSON API responses. It includes functionality for filtering fields based on sensitivity and visibility, formatting date strings into ISO 8601, and returning an AttributeResponse object with the prepared attributes.

classes.name: AttributeObjectHelper
classes.description: Helper class for extracting and formatting attributes from SugarBean objects for JSON API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a BeanManager instance.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves and formats attributes from a SugarBean, filtering out sensitive or non-API-visible fields, and formatting date strings into ISO 8601.
